newsitem.title: UK: European raw cotton still seen under pressure.
newsitem.headline: European raw cotton still seen under pressure.

text.p: Despite the partial recovery of New York cotton futures, the European raw cotton markets were seen as remaining under pressure, industry sources said.
The perception that an ample supply will be available as the main northern hemisphere crops move over the coming months continues to colour sentiment amongst spinners, they added.

Only the cheapest trade offers have thus commanded any real interest on the part of mill buyers. Central Asian styles have remained at the forefront of attention, while asking rates for Greek and Spanish are being closely monitored.
